scope: SMK-37 CLIP KEYS non-strum scale-snap and overlapping-chord NoteOn/NoteOff ownership; no BLE/SMC/OTA/storage/clock changes
intended_user_behavior: When two physical keys snap to one MIDI pitch, or two chords share a pitch, the audible pitch gets one NoteOn until the final physical owner releases. Voice refresh sends each pitch once rather than duplicate MIDI events.
failure_before: With C-major NEAR, key C and C# both generate MIDI C. A second key emits an additional NoteOn, but final release produces only one NoteOff; MIDI note balance remains +1. Voice refresh similarly emits duplicate off/on events.
fix: For single-key presses/releases suppress pitches owned by any other held key; for whole-voice off/on refresh suppress pitches already covered by an earlier scanned held key. The existing release path's exclusion of still-held tones is preserved.
